title: 조기진급 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 3 (Procedures for Early Promotion or Early Graduation)
(1) A student selected as eligible for early promotion or early graduation pursuant to Article 2 (hereinafter referred to as a "candidate for early promotion or graduation") who wishes to be promoted or graduate early shall obtain recognition from the head of the school for early completion of individual subjects included in the curriculum of the next school year.
(2) When recognizing early completion of individual subjects under paragraph (1), the head of the school shall obtain an assessment by the Committee for Evaluation of Early Promotion, Graduation and Admission under Article 5 (1).
(3) Where a candidate for early promotion or graduation has been recognized as having completed individual subjects early under paragraph (2) and has completed all courses necessary for promotion or graduation, the candidate may be promoted or graduate early.
(4) Detailed procedures and methods necessary for early promotion or early graduation shall be determined by the head of each school in the school rules.
